headline: Adin Ross reveals plans for a potential boxing match between Blueface and Adrien Broner at
body: Adin Ross reveals plans for a potential boxing match between Blueface and Adrien Broner at an upcoming Brand Risk event. During Brand Risk 16 on Oct. 16, Ross said he spoke with Blue’s manager, Wack 100 and mentioned that the West coast rapper is ready to step back into the ring to face Broner. The streamer claimed the matchup is going to happen. However, when Broner was later asked on his own stream why fans kept bringing up the fight, he responded, “They trippin’.
